items.title: Welspun Corp zooms 227% in 6 months; Jefferies projects further upside
items.description: Jefferies initiated coverage on Welspun Corp stock with a 'Buy' rating for a target price of ₹3,250 per share citing likely gains from an upcycle in oil & gas spends by the US and Middle East.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex rises 200 pts, Nifty near 24,000; Nifty IT tumbles 1% as Infosys, TCS drag
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap were trading 0.29 per cent and 0.82 per cent higher, respectively

items.title: Clean Max Enviro Energy share price rallies 7% after block deal action
items.description: Technical analyst advised investors to avoid fresh long positions for now and wait for a clear breakout above 1,400 before considering fresh buying.

items.title: Lumino Industries makes strong debut, lists at 34% premium on NSE
items.description: Lumino Industries shares listed at ₹109 on the BSE, a premium of 32.93 per cent against the offer price of ₹82. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange, it debuted at ₹110, up 34.15 per cent.

items.title: Rupee gains 69 paise, hits highest level since June on bumper FCNR inflows
items.description: The domestic currency touched an intraday high of 94.27 in morning deals, its highest level since June 29, according to Bloomberg data.

items.title: Nifty may test 23,600, says Ajit Mishra; bets on BEML among others
items.description: Religare Broking's Ajit Mishra said that the sharp decline has pushed Nifty closer to our initial downside target and support of 23,800. A break below this could extend the correction towards 23,600.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Meesho, SAIL, ICICI Bank, L&T Fin, Blue Star, OMCs & more
items.description: Meesho's shares will remain in focus after a likely block deal to sell 1.5 per cent of Meesho's paid-up equity by SoftBank Vision Fund entity SVF II Meerkat is expected today.

items.title: BEML, Raymond, IFCI: 3 breakout stocks on Bonanza's radar
items.description: Kunal Kamble of Bonanza has recommended three breakout stocks to buy today -- BEML Ltd, Raymond Ltd, and IFCI Ltd.

items.title: Global stocks climb as investors watch US-Iran conflict, yen surges
items.description: Global stock indexes mostly rose after three days of declines, while the yen jumped sharply and US Treasury yields eased as investors tracked the latest developments in the US-Iran conflict

items.title: Nifty to remain range-bound; Jatin Gedia recommends Meesho, 2 others
items.description: Jatin Gedia of Teji Mandi has said that he sees range-bound price action between 23,800 and 24,100 in Nifty from a short-term perspective.

items.title: Market rout brings dividend stocks in limelight: Time to switch?
items.description: Dividend stocks aren't immune to market-wide sell-offs, but their yields create a natural floor for the stock price. As the price drops, the yield rises, which naturally brings in value investors.
